decision.summaryForCoordinator: ACCEPT at 0 blockers and 0 SHOULD-FIX. Twenty-two attacks run, twenty-two refuted. The subject is a genuine remeasurement of frozen v2 onto live HEAD ffb6dc2 / file 08 f909ddff / required-now 28, with file 08 confirmed moved; both hygiene repairs landed and the ten-obligation leftoverDesign set is provably identical to v2. This row carries four separate ride boundaries and all four hold: DR-111 windows and DR-127 hostile goldens are quoted verbatim from v16's own rides block, DR-118/G13 stays reserved-not-required-now per G16's g13Split, and EE-7e stays riding G16 per its ee7e record. The CI-encoding reservation is quoted list-equal to v16's reservedForBlueprint with no concrete provider or YAML anywhere in the artifact, and the three corpus classes are quadruple-corroborated across G16 v2's three fields and the catalog. The artifact mints no number beyond its version and the required-now count.
